posts.title: Cloudflare Monetization Gateway: Letting AI Agents Pay per Request
posts.description: Cloudflare's Monetization Gateway puts a pay-per-request wall in front of APIs using x402 and HTTP 402. How it works, what setup costs and who can use it.

posts.title: Google Drive and Docs Now Handle Markdown Natively
posts.description: Google Docs can edit .md files without converting them. How to use it, which Docs formatting won't survive a save, and why Google pushes Markdown for AI agents.

posts.title: AI Hallucinations: Why Language Models Make Things Up
posts.description: Fake court cases, an airline chatbot inventing policy, code importing missing packages. Why language models hallucinate and how to keep the damage small.
